name: Elvis Njau
title: SOC Analyst (L2) / Detection Engineer
availability: Open to remote and on-site SOC Analyst (L2) and Detection Engineer roles
summary: BTL1- and SAL1-certified SOC analyst with 10 years in IT and about two years of hands-on SOC lab work. I investigate alerts, build detections in Splunk and Wazuh, and automate response with n8n.
objective: I am looking for a SOC analyst opportunity where I can investigate alerts, analyze endpoint and network telemetry, document incidents clearly, and help improve practical detection coverage.
aboutSenior: I spent ten years keeping business systems running, first as a hotel systems administrator and IT head, then running my own IT support firm. Since 2024 I have retrained in security operations. I build and test detections, hunt with Velociraptor, map findings to MITRE ATT&CK, and publish every lab with evidence.

careerTarget.summary: I am seeking a SOC Analyst (L2) or Detection Engineer role where I can investigate alerts end to end, build and tune detections across endpoint and network telemetry, and automate response playbooks.

Detection validation against MITRE ATT&CK techniques
Security automation and SOAR playbook development
System hardening and security control validation

skillGroups.title: Security Operations
skillGroups.description: SOC workflows, alert triage, incident classification, false-positive reduction, IOC correlation, Cyber Kill Chain analysis, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

skillGroups.title: Network & Detection
skillGroups.description: Packet analysis, IDS/IPS rule authoring, wireless assessment, MITM detection, and investigation of suspicious network activity.

skillGroups.title: Wireless Security
skillGroups.description: Controlled wireless reconnaissance, monitor-mode workflows, handshake capture, WPS testing, evil-twin simulation, and password-audit labs.

skillGroups.title: Endpoint & DFIR
skillGroups.description: Endpoint monitoring, forensic collection, disk and memory analysis, malware triage, response playbooks, and evidence preservation.

skillGroups.title: Application Security
skillGroups.description: OWASP-aligned web, API, and Android testing across authorization, authentication, injection, transport, storage, and client-side controls.

skillGroups.title: Reconnaissance
skillGroups.description: Passive and active discovery for target profiling, subdomain enumeration, DNS analysis, and attack-surface mapping.

skillGroups.title: Automation & SOAR
skillGroups.description: Security scripts, log parsing, IOC detection, API integrations, alert enrichment, ticketing pipelines, and repeatable analyst workflows.

skillGroups.title: Web & API Engineering
skillGroups.description: Static and dynamic application builds, REST API development, front-end interactions, backend services, test automation, and deployment support.

skillGroups.title: Cloud & GRC
skillGroups.description: AWS security reviews, IAM and S3 misconfiguration analysis, CloudTrail review, risk assessment, policies, and framework-based gap analysis.

skillGroups.title: Adversary Simulation
skillGroups.description: Controlled Windows and Active Directory exercises, privilege escalation, post-exploitation, and detection validation in authorized labs.

details: Earned BTL1, TryHackMe SAL1, and the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate.
Built a Splunk, n8n, DFIR-IRIS, Velociraptor, and Wazuh pipeline that runs from alert to host isolation.
Wrote Snort rules and validated them against captured scan and ICMP traffic.
Published 12 lab write-ups on GitHub with step-by-step evidence.
Founded and run an IT firm that offers IT support services.
Handle support, system setup, and maintenance for clients.
Led IT operations for servers, network, staff endpoints, POS, and property management systems.
Set secure practices for user access, patching, backups, and firewall rules.
Centralized monitoring and incident escalation across infrastructure and business applications.
Wrote recovery procedures and support playbooks for priority systems.
Managed vendors, asset lifecycles, and upgrades, and reported technical risk to management.
Administered Windows and Linux systems, network devices, workstations, and hotel applications.
Handled patching, account provisioning, endpoint hardening, malware protection, and backup checks.
Reviewed system, application, and network logs to troubleshoot faults and flag suspicious activity.
Ran backup and recovery, software deployments, and user support.
